name: United Kingdom
notes: House of Commons: 650 seats, first-past-the-post. 2024 result: Labour 411 seats (33.7%), Conservatives 121 (23.7%), Liberal Democrats 72 (12.2%), Reform UK 5 (14.3%), SNP 9 (2.5%), Green 4 (6.8%), Plaid Cymru 4 (0.7%). Next general election due no later than 15 August 2029.
